review_method: Connected registered Blueprint source graphs, runtime RootNode/Children behavior-tree links, EQS options/tests, class defaults and supporting schemas were read semantically. Generated duplicate graphs are not counted as additional behavior. Native calls are delimited dependencies, not reverse-engineered bodies.

assets.summary: Condition casts the owner to InfantryAIController and its pawn to Infantry_Pilot, then returns DestinationExists. Default inverse condition is false; tree instances can override decorator settings.
limitations: Failed casts have no explicit true result. Destination selection and Infantry_Pilot implementation are outside this export.

assets.summary: ReceiveExecute casts the owner and pawn to the infantry classes, sets IsCowering=true, then finishes successfully. TickInterval defaults to -1.
limitations: Failed casts have no connected FinishExecute. Animation and locomotion consequences of IsCowering are not exported here.

assets.summary: Builds a flee query center from player-character index 0 toward OwnerActor, scales the horizontal direction by 7500, adds OwnerActor location, queries navigation within 2000, writes its FleeLocation key and finishes true.
limitations: OwnerActor location is used, not an explicit controlled-pawn location. Navigation-query success is not checked; a returned vector is not proof of a traversable escape. Values are raw coordinate units.

assets.summary: Gets an AI controller from OwnerActor, requires InfantryAIController, calls ArriveAtTarget and finishes true. The AtTarget key is not consumed on this path.
limitations: Failure to cast has no connected finish. Reused by tank/VTOL hold trees despite the infantry-specific cast; execution and assignment must be observed before calling this a game defect.

assets.summary: Gets the owner AI controller and Infantry_Pilot pawn, copies DestinationLocation to the selected VehicleLocation blackboard vector and finishes true.
limitations: Does not itself choose a destination or prove path feasibility. Failed casts have no connected finish.

assets.summary: Root selects non-burning or burning behavior. Non-burning runs Wait 2 with 0.5 deviation, FindFleeLocation, MoveTo MoveLocation with 500 acceptable radius, then Cower; burning runs OnFire then MoveTo. Burning decorators abort both ways.
limitations: MoveTo, navigation and burning/pilot state implementation remain dependencies. Timing and coordinates are serialized configuration, not measured gameplay.

assets.summary: Non-burning workers with DestinationExists copy the destination, move to MoveLocation with 300 acceptable radius and GroundAI_Filter, then notify arrival. Burning branch selects a random nearby location and moves.
limitations: Worker route allocation and whether a unit receives this tree are not established for all infantry.

assets.summary: Infantry controller/pawn casts read the inherited Infantry.OnFire flag as the condition; default inverse is false.
limitations: Does not define fire damage, duration or how OnFire is set. Cast failure has no explicit successful return.

assets.summary: On execute, casts owner to InfantryAIController, queries a random navigable location within 400 of its pawn, writes the configured flee vector, and finishes true.
limitations: Navigation-query success is unused. This is burning movement, not damage or extinguishing logic.

assets.summary: Human blackboard inherits MWBlackboard and adds MoveLocation as a vector.
limitations: Parent keys and their native writers are separate evidence. A key declaration is not runtime population.

assets.summary: Start calls RunBehaviorTree with BT_GarrisonWorker; Flee calls BT_Flee; ArriveAtTarget casts its pawn and calls ReachedTarget. BeginPlay/Tick are unconnected. Defaults have no DefaultBehaviorTree, no PrimaryCombatTactic and bStartAILogicOnPossess=false.
limitations: Start/Flee callers and Infantry_Pilot body are not collected here. This maps workers and fleeing pilots, not all armed infantry.

assets.summary: Long-range condition succeeds if the tank controller reports OnlyHasLRMs, otherwise tests its MWTank pawn bFightFromLongRange; controller or pawn cast failure returns false.
limitations: OnlyHasLRMs implementation and weapon range calculation are native dependencies.

assets.summary: Execute gets player pawn index 0 and requires MWMech, sets the owner combat target and FireAt interaction through interfaces, then finishes using bSuccess. Cast failure sets bSuccess=false; default bSuccess=true.
limitations: Player index 0 targeting is special-purpose behavior, not proof that general enemy AI always targets the human. Interface calls are not firing receipts.

assets.summary: Sets combat interaction then loops: with a target, queries TankCombatCircle and chooses long-range move with TankLRMBruteForce EQS service or ordinary circle-query movement and 0.1 wait; without a target waits 1. Long-range service interval 1 and move radius 500 are serialized. Stored MoveTo_8 and its EQS service have no root-connected path.
limitations: Native movement/EQS bodies and exact chosen positions are unavailable. Unconnected stored nodes are not active branches.

assets.summary: Root prioritizes combat when a target exists, otherwise branches on FormationTravelActor, destination status and distance to follow a formation actor or TravelLocation. Movement radii include 10, 1000, 2300 and 5000 in raw coordinates; final-destination task is explicit.
limitations: Effective movement depends on native MWMoveTo and formation state producers. Collected tree existence does not establish every vehicle assignment.

assets.summary: Infinite root selects a sequence moving to TravelLocation if not at it, calling human BTTask_ReachTarget at destination, finishing when MissionOrders is None and waiting 0.5; fallback waits.
limitations: Human ReachTarget dependency requires InfantryAIController, a mismatch requiring a narrow runtime test. No tested tank Stop behavior is claimed.

assets.summary: Tank root updates senses, skips active tree when Idle, and orders branches: flee location, mission orders, can-attack aggressive combat, suspicion scouting, waypoint movement, then home movement/ambient. Native PickCombatTarget auto-attack service runs at 1 plus 0.25 deviation; patrol route service maintains waypoints.
limitations: Native target ranking, path following and concrete spawned-controller assignment remain unknown. Mission orders precede autonomous combat in the serialized tree.

assets.summary: Root selector connects only MissionOrders Stop (integer 5) to TankHoldPosition, then a Wait fallback. Stored Follow/Attack/Move subgraphs are not reachable from this runtime root.
limitations: Not evidence that every tank ignores those commands: actual runtime asset assignment, overrides and cooked asset parity are unverified.

assets.summary: Allowlisted /Game/AI/Tank/Behaviors/BT_VTOLHoldPosition has no source/default export and is categorized invalid or redirected metadata. Separate VTOL-folder asset 147 is reviewed.
limitations: No exact redirect resolution is asserted. Treat this inventory entry as unavailable, not reviewed or silently substituted.

assets.summary: Allowlisted /Game/AI/Tank/Behaviors/BT_VTOLTeamOrders has no source/default export and is categorized invalid or redirected metadata. Separate VTOL-folder asset 149 is reviewed;148 runtime reference explicitly names that VTOL-folder asset.
limitations: Raw metadata frontier still mentions the Tank path. Metadata references and resolved export references are distinguished; no recollection performed.

assets.summary: Not-at-final-destination branch moves along a waypoint with 2300 acceptable radius then marks final-destination state; final branch calls FireAtPlayer and waits 0.25. Patrol service updates route/waypoint.
limitations: Scripted player-target behavior is not a general combat policy. Movement helper and target firing internals are dependencies.

assets.summary: Patrol root moves to a set waypoint if not within 200 and key is unchanged; otherwise waits 0.25. UpdatePatrolRoute service and stuck checking are configured.
limitations: Recovery and route choice bodies are native/dependent.

assets.summary: Tank blackboard inherits MWUnitBlackboard and adds IsAtDestination boolean.
limitations: Blackboard schema does not establish producers or timing.

assets.summary: Execute casts owner to MWAIController, reads suspicion actor, focuses its pawn if it is a Controller, otherwise the actor itself; then finishes true.
limitations: Look-focus native implementation and cast-failure behavior are not established beyond visible connections.

assets.summary: Turret root sets raw target-strategy enum value 2, updates senses and, when not Idle, prioritizes CanAttack combat interaction/wait, suspicion rotation/wait, then nearby-player look-around. Native PickCombatTarget auto-attack service is 1 plus 0.25 deviation.
limitations: Strategy enum 2 is not given an invented tactical meaning. Suspicion location gates a task reading suspicion actor; consistency of those keys requires observation.

assets.summary: Turret blackboard only declares parent MWUnitBlackboard, with no additional keys.
limitations: Shared keys do not prove identical behavior or hostility rules.

assets.summary: Sets combat interaction and loops: with target, runs VTOLCircle RandomBest 25Pct, moves to TravelLocation with 1000 acceptable radius and a10-second EQS update service, then waits 0.1; without target waits 1.
limitations: RandomBest 25Pct is configured selection, not globally optimal firing-position search. Actual native move/weapon behavior is unobserved.

assets.summary: VTOLCircle generates six points on a25000-radius, 60-degree arc centered on combat target and oriented to its view direction; native VTOLOptimalElevation overrides default 8000 height. Score-only tests include distance from VTOLs, a 2D distance term, combat-target visibility trace and tether shape.
limitations: Score-only visibility is not a mandatory LOS filter. Distance 2D omits its DistanceTo context, so own-distance semantics require native-default confirmation. Provider values, complete scoring defaults and native tether test cannot be inferred from omitted fields. Raw coordinates only.

assets.summary: Ambient VTOL resets ambient location, repeatedly queries ambient candidates RandomBest 25Pct, moves with 900 acceptance under not-at-location/force-success decorators and waits 3 plus 1 deviation; home-location change abort tolerance 100.
limitations: Force-success changes branch completion, not path validity. Assignment to a spawned VTOL remains unverified.

assets.summary: Ambient location EQS uses a5000-radius circle centered on Context_AmbientLocation, no trace, navigation projection defaults, and a score-only distance test.
limitations: FloatValueMin 50 appears in a score-only test and must not be reported as a hard minimum distance.

assets.summary: VTOL follow prioritizes existing-target aggressive combat; otherwise follows a set FormationTravelActor with 10000 acceptable radius and 5000 observed-location tolerance.
limitations: These are large raw coordinate tolerances, not proof of formation quality. Actor identity and runtime assignment remain unverified.

assets.summary: VTOL hold-position root moves to TravelLocation, calls the same human ReachTarget task when at it, conditionally finishes when orders clear, and waits 0.5 with fallback.
limitations: Infantry-specific ReachTarget reuse is a validation lead, not a proven shipping defect.

assets.summary: VTOL master orders flee, mission orders, aggressive combat, scouting, waypoint, home/ambient beneath not-Idle with senses/target services. RunBehavior runtime reference points to /Game/AI/VTOL/Behaviors/BT_VTOLTeamOrders, resolving the local reviewed dependency 149 independently of stale Tank-folder metadata.
limitations: Native target selection and real mission assignment are not collected gameplay evidence.

assets.summary: Root connects only Stop to VTOLHoldPosition, Follow to VTOLFollow, and Wait fallback. Attack/Move sequences exist in storage but are disconnected from the runtime root.
limitations: Do not infer a shipping command bug or universal vehicle behavior without assignment and execution evidence.

assets.summary: Tutorial FireAndStrafe tick initializes the tutorial spawner/VTOL once, copies CombatWaypoints, writes Destination, advances when XY distance is below 2750, and loops at the last waypoint. Default interval 0.5 plus 0.1 deviation.
limitations: Despite its name the connected service does not directly issue a fire call. Initialization success, waypoint validity and concrete assignment are unverified.

assets.summary: Tutorial FlyToAndFire uses spawner Waypoints, writes successive destinations at XY distance below 2750, then marks local and blackboard final-destination state. Default interval 0.5 plus 0.1; BT 155 instance overrides 0.03 with no deviation.
limitations: Serialized interval is not achieved sampling latency. Empty paths/cast failure are not guaranteed to recover.

assets.summary: Tutorial target task obtains its AbstractVTOL from blackboard SelfActor, the tutorial spawner and Targets array, randomly selects a valid actor, then sets combat target through its AI controller and finishes true.
limitations: No hostility/visibility check on this path; invalid selection and failed casts have no connected finish. Do not generalize tutorial target availability.

assets.summary: Gets tutorial VTOL AI controller from blackboard SelfActor, sets FireAt interaction through an interface and finishes true. It does not itself choose a random target; stored direct-property/debug nodes are disconnected.
limitations: FireAt interface invocation is not a measured shot. Depends on separate target-selection task 152.

assets.summary: Drone ambient tree resets ambient location, loops EQS selection, force-success movement with 1000 acceptable radius and wait 0.5 plus 0.25 deviation, and aborts when home changes.
limitations: Tutorial/ambient configuration is not enemy-wide piloting policy.

assets.summary: FlyToAndFire tree approaches Destination until IsAtDestination, then selects a random target and runs movement plus fire interaction through a simple parallel; FireAndStrafe service updates destination. Root FlyToAndFire service interval 0.03.
limitations: Parallel task semantics and actual firing/navigation require runtime verification; tutorial spawner references differ from general VTOL combat.

assets.summary: Drone ambient EQS is a circle radius 500 with spacing 500 centered on ambient context and a score-only distance test.
limitations: No hard minimum-distance or LOS filter is established by this query.

assets.summary: VTOL blackboard extends MWUnitBlackboard with Destination vector, IsAtDestination boolean, Spawner object and IsAtStrafeDestination boolean.
limitations: Declaration is not proof all keys are written in every tree.

assets.summary: Abstract pilot encounter declares empty extension points for setup, spawning, manning and reaching targets; GetUnitsAvailable returns its empty default output. Construction forwards parent; ordinary actor events are unconnected.
limitations: Concrete subclasses/native encounter machinery are outside this asset. Default SpawnRadius is not a universal spawn distance.

assets.summary: Ambush trigger requires an unpaused/untriggered hostile overlap by player-squad member, nonempty deck, speed>100 and heading dot>0.6 toward encounter locator. It partitions VTOL/vehicle/mech cards into ground or reinforcement spawning. UnitSpawned adds player-squad actors to awareness and sets Attack/large idle-distance value on valid targets/blackboard.
limitations: Ground-weight local default 200 is configuration; native spawner results, reinforcement availability and enemy knowledge cannot be assumed universally. Target seeding is mission-side information, not legal companion observation.

assets.summary: Setup binds reinforcement-arrival callbacks; Start activates units. A valid arriving unit is added to the first dispatch target encounter and assigned that target job board. Stored map/home-location alternatives are unconnected.
limitations: DispatchTargets[0] requires valid configuration. Unit addition and board assignment do not independently prove movement/arrival.

assets.summary: Reads units/base-REDCON/increase from additional data. Start binds first target inner zone, constructs critical AlertGarrisonJob and posts it with UseSpecificUnits=false, then transfers listed units and assigns board. First matching usable unit reaching the zone signals successful dispatch. Defaults increase 1,base 2.
limitations: Listed GUIDs are not a dispatch-selection restriction when UseSpecificUnits is false. Completion means a qualifying arrival, not arrival of every unit.

assets.summary: Blank-garrison hostile overlap once-awake path posts patrol and turret-guard jobs and sets IsAwakened. The visible K2_IsEnabled(garrisonbehavior) false branch has no execution successor, unlike standard garrison.
limitations: Requires targeted assignment/debug-state test before alleging a shipped defect. Return false is not equivalent to no internal side effects.

assets.summary: Standard garrison starts REDCON at 4, updates alert state on hostile identification/sensing/overlap/building changes, wakes configured spawns and posts patrol/guard jobs. It tracks known targets across encounter awareness components, selects faction/attitude commander dialogue and gates 8-second radar sweeps with 30-second cooldown.
limitations: Uses shared native awareness and job machinery. Faction dialogue differences are not proof of separate ally/enemy locomotion AI. Lower REDCON numeric values mean higher alert through the base subtracting increase method.

assets.summary: Wave EQS context accepts a DispatchWaves component or DispatchWavesToGoToLocation mission component, chooses a random configured mission-flow location, resolves its locator and outputs actor position.
limitations: Empty lists, locator validity and native GetLocator resolution are not proven safe by the visible path.

assets.summary: Dispatch wave enum labels distinguish AttackBuildings, AttackPlayerLance and GoToHomeLocation.
limitations: Labels gain execution meaning only through 222 switch connections.

assets.summary: Wave component selects wave-specific additional-data units excluding left-play list, activates/transfers them, posts critical jobs against destructibles or player squad, or writes home destinations from EQS. Next wave is timer-driven or waits for current wave left-play count to zero; minimum fallback delay 0.01. Default CurrentWave 1 and WaveType 0.
limitations: OnUnitLeftPlay is broader than proven combat death. Failed query can still set QueryRun and flush destination queue; empty result handling needs a targeted test. Spawn/job calls are not gameplay receipts.

assets.summary: Wave home-location EQS generates 20 circle points at radius 11000 around Context_WaveLocation and projects to navmesh with vertical extents 1000000; no tests are serialized.
limitations: Serialized ArcAngle 60 alone does not establish arc mode because bDefineArc is not set. No cover, danger or LOS optimization is demonstrated.

assets.summary: BehaviorTypes enumerates standard/blank garrison, building/player/new-home waves, reinforcement dispatch, alert dispatch and ambush component variants.
limitations: Selection mappings are implemented in EncounterClassParent; enum entries alone do not execute behavior.

assets.summary: DispatchMode declares Full, Strike, Assault and Scout labels.
limitations: No distinct complete tactical policy follows from these labels or the Strike default alone.

assets.summary: Base encounter component connects overlap/attitude dispatch, relevant GUID lookup, awareness subscriptions, unit lifecycle and job-board transfer. Increase REDCON subtracts and Decrease adds, passing Min=1 and Max=MinimumREDCON to Clamp. Activation delegates to reinforcements; base hooks mostly return false; setup conditionally binds observers. Default tick capability is false.
limitations: MinimumREDCON defaults to 0, so a valid Clamp interval depends on initialization; standard garrison separately initializes it to 4. Native sensors/spawn helpers and shared function-library bodies are dependencies. Return booleans do not universally summarize side effects; ActivateUnitsForJobs returns HasActivated=false despite a post call.

assets.summary: Dispatch base configures wave-locator decks, transfers units, handles hotdrop ground/air capacities and queues vehicle spawns on a grid. Grid uses default 16 spots and per-call cell size; team information is applied at call sites. Remaining units fall through to parent activation.
limitations: Queued spawn is not an observed spawn. No universal player-exclusion distance is established. One wave-locator MoveUnitData path supplies the created encounter as both self and destination, requiring a targeted trace before assigning effects.

assets.summary: UnitActivationType has independent Spawned, InGarage and InReinforcementDrop flags; Spawned tooltip explicitly excludes job assignment.
limitations: Flags are bookkeeping, not proof of a live actor or running job.

assets.summary: Encounter parent owns GUID-to-unit metadata, activation/usage/type/death filtering, board construction, target/building/spawner inventories, critical posting wrappers and queued spawn lifecycle. Registered source paths queue spawns; callbacks attach sensors/pilot component and update activation. Behavior selection creates component variants. Editor autofill/capacity and test helpers are separate from runtime policy.
limitations: Type-tag filter appends when HasTag=false, so it must not be assumed to be an inclusion filter. Native queue/job bodies and level-specific assignment remain unknown. Stored direct-spawn alternatives are disconnected. LeftPlay sets IsDead, which does not establish cause of removal.

assets.summary: EncounterUnitData stores activation flags, deck usage, unit type tag and IsDead.
limitations: This is encounter accounting; it is not a full combat snapshot or reliable casualty cause without lifecycle context.
